item.title: "Devourer" Single Release
item.description:
The right tunes can make all the difference when travelling afar, and your upcoming journey to the Tau System is no exception. Fortunately, we've just made another stellar musical track from the ingenious Warframe Sound Team available for your listening pleasure on major streaming platforms.

"Devourer," was first heard during the Epoch Operation: Taubound Official Gameplay Teaser. Influenced by slow, heavy metal from the likes of Black Sabbath, it features lyrics "sung" in Voidtongue, the terrifyingly enigmatic language of the Untime. This was a deliberate choice, recalling the memorable moment from 2023's Whispers in the Walls Quest when you took control of one of Albrecht Entrati's Vessels for the first time.

Here, these elements combine for a musical experience that feels as massive and imposing as your latest endeavors ahead of Warframe: Tau, coming later this year.

Where can I listen?

You can listen to "Devourer" on:
  • Spotify
  • Apple Music
  • YouTube Music
  • Amazon Music
  • Tidal
  • Deezer
  • Bandcamp

FULL TRACKLIST:

item.title: Epoch Operation: Taubound
item.description:
Arturos and Zioa have lain dormant long enough: the time to assume control of your Vessel is almost at hand. With new worlds and possibilities beyond the Origin System closer than ever, your window to prepare for the journey to Tau begins now, ahead of a never-before-seen, one-time Epoch Operation beginning soon on October 15.



WHAT IS THE OPERATION?
Epoch Operation: Taubound will open a path to the Tau System with help from the Sentient Mothership, Praghasa. Facilitating your travels will require an extraordinary amount of energy on her part, so you will need to collect fuel to provide the strength she needs.


Playing as your Warframe, you will need to visit Mission nodes across Eris to collect Moonflesh for Praghasa. In exchange for this viscous resource, she will offer a number of Rewards, as well as daily login messages for the duration of the Operation.


This event calls for the collective participation of Tenno from across the entire community.


WHEN IS IT?
Epoch Operation: Taubound begins October 15 and will run for one month only, concluding on November 17.


HOW DO I PARTICIPATE?
Completing any Mission on Eris will provide Moonflesh, which can be traded to Praghasa for unique Rewards. Users who interact with Praghasa will also get special, daily narrative updates exclusive to the event.


Note: All Tenno who have completed Vor's Prize will be able to access Eris during Epoch Operation: Taubound. The normal Star Chart and Junction requirements will be lifted for this event.


WHAT IF I MISS IT?
There will be no reruns of Epoch Operation: Taubound. Be sure to visit Praghasa during the event so that you can experience her unique dialogue and Rewards before November 17. This is your chance to be a part of Warframe history!


WHAT ABOUT MY VESSEL?


Separate from Epoch Operation: Taubound, you will also find a new Tau Prologue Quest added to your Codex starting on October 15. This Quest is a permanent new addition to the Warframe Codex that will remain in place even after Epoch Operation: Taubound ends and can be completed at your leisure. While it is narratively connected to the limited-time event, it is not related to the Rewards or dialogue found in this Epoch Operation.

Note: You must complete The Hex and The Old Peace Quests to access the Tau Prologue Quest. This is not required to harvest Moonflesh as part of Epoch Operation: Taubound.

If you would like to complete these Quests before Epoch Operation: Taubound, there's still time! Head over to our official Warframe Quest Guide for help navigating your way through Quest order.

--

BEGIN YOUR JOURNEY

item.title: The Icebind is live now!
item.description:
A new challenge arrives atop the Yuvan Peak, Tenno! Rally your squad, ring the Cryobell and overcome the Binds if you can.

The Icebind is an experimental new game mode meant to give you the space to push your loadouts and tackle cooperative objectives. Six-player Squads. Level 999+ Enemies. Randomized modifiers known as Binds. Guaranteed Riven Splicer Rewards with bonus Rewards based on Side Objectives.

Will you have what it takes to take on The Icebind?

Learn more about The Icebind in our guide video below or in the full Dev Workshop.


To play The Icebind, you must have completed the Angels of the Zariman and Whispers in the Walls Quests as well as unlocked Elite Temporal or Deep Archimedea.

item.title: October in Warframe
item.description:
As the seasons change, so does the Origin System. And this October is no exception, with plenty of seasonal, returning, and brand new additions to occupy you as we draw ever closer to Warframe: Tau later this year.

Watch for the following events this month:

EPOCH OPERATION: TAUBOUND
October 15 - November 17


A unique event unlike anything you've experienced to date, Epoch Operation: Taubound offers all eligible Tenno the chance to become a part of Warframe history. If you want to help open up a path to the Tau System, be sure to have your account ready by completing the "Vor's Prize" Quest before October 15.

Players looking to pilot their Vessel for the first time can also complete The Hex and The Old Peace in order to access a new, permanent Prologue Quest setting up the Road to Tau.

For full event details – including prerequisites and more – click here.


NIGHTS OF NABERUS
October 1 @ 11 a.m. ET - November 2 @ 11 a.m. ET


Spooky season returns to the Origin System during our annual Halloween-inspired event, with Daughter releasing her inventory of new and returning seasonal Customizations in exchange for Mother Tokens. While Baro Ki'Teer will mark the occasion in the same unsettling fashion as last year (IYKYK), we're also mixing it up by bringing back the Hallowed Nightmares Tactical Alert, allowing you to face off against the fearsome Jack O'Naut for even more Naberus treats.

For all the harrowing details, check out our Halloween 2026 Events post.


NEW GAME MODE: THE ICEBIND
October 7


Originally intended to ship alongside Iceblade of Narin as "Glacial Defiance," our new 6-player game mode was ultimately delayed to allow for additional development time and renamed to The Icebind. Accessible in-game starting October 7, these challenging, high-level Missions can be played up to three times weekly, allowing you to put your teamwork (and Loadouts) to the test for valuable Rewards.

Visit the official Warframe Forums to learn more about the delay, and further details of the game mode itself.


PRINCESS MARGARET CANCER FOUNDATION QUEST
October 1 - October 31


PMCF Quest (formerly Quest to Conquer Cancer) returns for another October full of special Community streams, donation incentives and Conquera Customizations. Join us all month long and help support The Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation light the way towards a world free from the fear of cancer.

Visit the Warframe PMCF Quest webpage for more information or donate directly here.

item.title: Protea Prime and Ivara Prime Enter Prime Resurgence
item.description:
Protea Prime
A master of battlefield preparation, Protea Prime brings tactical ingenuity and devastating technology to every mission. Deploy her arsenal, control the flow of combat and keep your squad supplied while turning the battlefield to your advantage.

Protea Prime is a versatile addition to any Arsenal, giving Tenno the tools to adapt to whatever the Origin System throws their way.


Ivara Prime
Stalking from the shadows and waiting for the perfect moment to strike, Ivara Prime is a huntress ready to claim her prey.

Ivara Prime draws her bow and disappears into the shadows before striking with deadly precision. With a versatile Quiver, powerful Artemis Bow and the ability to move unseen, Ivara Prime is a natural choice for Tenno who prefer stealth and careful execution.


Prime Warframes
Want to learn more about Prime Warframes?

Check out our Guide to Prime Warframes video for a helpful breakdown of what Prime Warframes are, different ways you can earn them and how you can purchase Prime items.

item.title: PMCF Quest 2026
item.description:
PMCF Quest (formerly Quest to Conquer Cancer) returns for another October full of special Community streams, donation incentives and Conquera Customizations. Join us all month long and help us support The Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation.

There are multiple ways to show support and make donations!

Watch on Twitch
Watch official Warframe and participating Warframe Content Creator livestreams and donate via the Team Warframe Tiltify donation page.

Conquera Merch
Help us reach every donation goal while reinforcing your IRL Arsenal! Check out the all-new Conquera Merch available this year. Total net-proceeds from sales of Conquera Merch will be donated at the end of the campaign.

In-Game
Support alongside fellow Tenno by picking up squishable versions of Valkyr and Voruna from the in-game Market! Purchasing these Floofs with Paid Platinum will contribute to the collective goal of selling both 40,000 Voruna Floofs and 40,000 Valkyr Floofs! Digital Extremes will donate an additional $20,000 CAD towards the PMCFQ campaign once each of these goals have been met. They will also become available to purchase with Personal Platinum at the time that they reach their respective goal.

See all the Rewards and the full livestream schedule including our epic finale at warframe.com/pmcfq

item.title: Warframe’s Halloween 2026 Events
item.description:
With Iceblade of Narin now live, there's lots to see and do at Yuvan Peak and elsewhere aboard the Zariman. But after you've had a chance to explore our latest update, the spooky season beckons…

Move from the chilly to the chilling with a look at Warframe's seasonal October content below:

Nights of Naberus
October 1 @ 11 a.m. ET - November 2 @ 11 a.m. ET


Your favorite spine-tingling, seasonal event is back with a bevy of bone-chilling items available from Daughter in exchange for Mother Tokens. Alongside a full inventory of previous offerings, you'll also find some tempting new treats, including:
  • Calaverita Liset Skin
  • Follie Coulrophobia Glyph
  • Voruna Prime Massacre Glyph
  • Sirius vs. Orion Poster
As in years past, Mother Tokens can be obtained by completing Bounties in the Cambion Drift, or by trading additional Resources with Grandmother.


Hallowed Nightmares
October 1 @ 11 a.m. ET - November 2 @ 11 a.m. ET

During the Nights of the Naberus, you'll have the opportunity to take on a Halloween-themed Tactical Alert not seen for several years. Face down the fearsome Jack O'Naut to earn the all-new Jack O’Naut Keychain Sugatra along with:
  • Jack O'Naut Recall Glyph
  • Manic Noggle
  • 50,000 Credits

"Scare-o" Ki'Teer Returns
October 16 @ 9 a.m. ET - November 8 @ 9 a.m. ET


The Void Trader's vexing variant will once again make a series of weekend appearances all month long, offering his usual wares along with some beautifully baleful items you haven't seen before! If you enjoyed his unique inventory last time around, you won't want to miss what he's bringing to this year's bizarre bazaar starting at 9 a.m. ET and ending at 9 a.m. ET on the following dates:
  • Visit 1: October 16 - October 18
  • Visit 2: October 23 - October 25
  • Visit 3: October 30 - November 1
  • Visit 4: November 6 - November 8

Tennotober
October 1 @ 12:01 a.m. ET - October 31 @ 11:59 p.m. ET


It wouldn't be fall without Tennotober, Warframe's community art challenge supporting the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation Quest. Find this year's guidelines and prompts on the official Warframe Forums, where you can share your illustrations and Capturas to participate.


Excalibur Nights of Naberus Plushie Giveaway
October 1 @ 11 a.m. ET - October 9 @ 11 a.m. ET


We've collaborated with our friends at Makeship to bring you a delightfully devilish new plushie version of Excalibur. Adorned with the Nyctalus Ephemera and colored for the occasion, the master swordsman looks markedly malevolent yet cuddly as ever. We're giving one away to three lucky Tenno who enter our giveaway via Gleam.

item.title: Iceblade of Narin Official Soundtrack
item.description:
Amid the frigid fanfare of our Iceblade of Narin launch, we're proud to once again deliver Warframe's latest musical tracks to major streaming platforms for your listening enjoyment.

The talent, creativity and ingenuity of our remarkable Sound Team reverberates across the three tracks comprising this release. Drawing inspiration from a traditional Korean musical style called Sanjo, each song evokes the powerful, dynamic movements of a sword dancer — just like our 66th Warframe, Narin.

The melodies recorded for Neote's Dance also inspired the vocals in Ice Speaker, which further combines familiar tunes associated with both the Zariman and the Man in the Wall for a unique aural motif befitting the narrative strands threaded through our latest update (as well as the intensity of the upcoming Glacial Defiance game mode).

Where can I listen?
You can find the Iceblade of Narin Official Soundtrack on:
